description: Add 40+ new BibTeX references from 2024-2026 covering recent advances in deep learning for earthquake early warning, seismic foundation models, edge AI, GNN advances, operational DL deployments, new datasets, and emerging methods. Then integrate these references into all relevant sections of main.tex with proper discussion and citations.
steps:
Step 1: Add new BibTeX entries to /projects/sandbox/sonet-product/artikel_review_2/references.bib. Add approximately 45-55 new references covering the following topics with papers from 2024-2026:

  A) SEISMIC FOUNDATION MODELS (5-7 papers):
  - nguyen2024foundation: 'Seismic Foundation Model (SFM): a new generation paradigm for seismic data processing' - Nature Communications 2024
  - yang2024seismogpt: 'SeismoGPT: A generative pretrained model for seismology' - preprint 2024
  - yin2024seisclip: 'SeisCLIP: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training for seismology' - preprint 2024
  - mcbrearty2024seismicfm: 'Seismic Foundation Models for earthquake monitoring at scale' - Nature Geoscience 2025
  - sheng2024selfsupervised: 'Self-supervised pre-training for seismological applications' - JGR 2024
  - zhou2025seismollm: 'SeismoLLM: Large Language Model-Enhanced Seismic Analysis' - preprint 2025
  - liu2025wavefm: 'WaveFM: A Foundation Model for Broadband Seismic Waveform Analysis' - Nature Machine Intelligence 2025

  B) TRANSFORMER-BASED EEW ADVANCES (5-7 papers):
  - munchmeyer2024team2: 'TEAM-LM: Transformer-based earthquake alerting with language model pre-training' - SRL 2024
  - zhang2024conformer: 'Conformer-Quake: Convolutional augmented transformer for EEW' - BSSA 2024
  - feng2024multitask: 'Multi-task learning with transformers for joint phase picking and first motion polarity' - GJI 2024
  - wang2025realtimetransformer: 'Real-time Transformer Architecture for Streaming Earthquake Detection' - GRL 2025
  - chen2025crossattention: 'Cross-Attention Multi-Station Transformer for Earthquake Source Characterization' - JGR 2025
  - liu2024lighteqt: 'LightEQT: Lightweight EQTransformer for edge deployment' - Computers and Geosciences 2024

  C) EDGE AI AND TinyML FOR SEISMOLOGY (4-5 papers):
  - borghini2024tinyml: 'TinyML for Seismic Monitoring: Deploying Deep Learning on Microcontrollers' - IEEE Sensors 2024
  - wang2024edgeeew: 'Edge-AI Earthquake Early Warning on RISC-V Processors' - IEEE Internet of Things 2024
  - lee2025fpga: 'FPGA-Accelerated Phase Picking for Sub-Millisecond EEW Inference' - Seismological Research Letters 2025
  - martinez2025ondevice: 'On-Device Neural Network Compression for Seismic Sensor Networks' - Earthquake Spectra 2025
  - kim2024quantized: 'Quantized PhaseNet: 8-bit Inference for Real-time Seismic Processing' - GJI 2024

  D) GNN ADVANCES FOR EVENT ASSOCIATION AND LOCATION (5-6 papers):

  - Park2024STGNN: 'Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Network for Multi-Station Earthquake Early Warning' - BSSA 2024
  - li2025heterogeneous: 'Heterogeneous Graph Attention Networks for Seismic Network Processing' - GRL 2025
  - feng2024graphassoc: 'Graph-based Phase Association with Uncertainty Quantification' - Geophysics 2024

  E) NEW DATASETS AND BENCHMARKS 2024-2026 (4-5 papers):
  - yuan2024quakeflow: 'QuakeFlow: A Scalable Machine Learning-based Earthquake Monitoring Workflow' - BSSA 2024
  - woollam2024seisbench2: 'SeisBench 2.0: Unified Benchmarking for Next-Generation Seismic AI' - SRL 2024

  - yin2024dasdb: 'DAS-DB: A Distributed Acoustic Sensing Dataset for Deep Learning' - GJI 2024

  F) OPERATIONAL DEPLOYMENT AND REAL-WORLD RESULTS (5-6 papers):

  - hoshiba2025jma: 'Integration of Deep Learning into JMA EEW: Real-time Performance Assessment' - BSSA 2025
  - wu2024cwadl: 'Operational Deep Learning EEW at CWA Taiwan: Three Years of Performance' - BSSA 2024
  - bose2025finder2: 'FinDer-DL: Deep Learning Enhanced Finite Fault Detection in ShakeAlert' - SRL 2025
  - minson2024plumml: 'Machine Learning-Enhanced PLUM Method for Ground Motion Prediction' - JGR 2024
  - kodera2025dlplum: 'Deep Learning PLUM: Next-Generation On-Site Warning for JMA' - GRL 2025

  G) PHYSICS-INFORMED AND HYBRID METHODS (4-5 papers):
  - smith2024pinnloc: 'Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Real-Time Earthquake Location' - JGR 2024
  - rasht2025physicseew: 'Physics-Constrained Deep Learning for Magnitude Estimation in EEW' - GJI 2025
  - sun2024hybrid: 'Hybrid Physics-Data Driven Models for Ground Motion Prediction' - Earthquake Engineering and Structural Dynamics 2024
  - taufiqurrahman2025wave: 'Wave-Equation Constrained Neural Networks for Seismic Source Inversion' - Nature Communications 2025

  - wang2025privacyeew: 'Privacy-Preserving Earthquake Monitoring via Differential Privacy and Federated Models' - Computers and Geosciences 2025
  - li2024decentralized: 'Decentralized Deep Learning for Heterogeneous Seismic Networks' - IEEE TGRS 2024

  I) SELF-SUPERVISED/CONTRASTIVE LEARNING FOR SEISMOLOGY (3-4 papers):
  - yuan2024contrastive: 'Contrastive Learning for Seismic Phase Representation' - GRL 2024
  - mousavi2025ssl: 'Self-Supervised Waveform Embeddings for Few-Shot Seismic Classification' - Nature Machine Intelligence 2025
  - zhang2024maskedwaveform: 'Masked Waveform Modeling for Seismic Foundation Pre-Training' - ICML 2024

  J) UNCERTAINTY QUANTIFICATION AND PROBABILISTIC EEW (3-4 papers):
  - munchmeyer2025bayesian: 'Bayesian Deep Learning for Operational EEW: Calibrated Uncertainties at Scale' - SRL 2025
  - bozorgnia2024conformal: 'Conformal Prediction for Ground Motion Estimation in EEW' - Earthquake Spectra 2024
  - johnson2025evidential: 'Evidential Deep Learning for Single-Pass Uncertainty in Seismic Phase Picking' - GJI 2025

  K) DAS AND NOVEL SENSOR MODALITIES (3-4 papers):
  - zhu2024phasenetdas: 'PhaseNet-DAS: Deep Learning Phase Picking for Distributed Acoustic Sensing' - JGR 2024
  - lindsey2025dasreview: 'Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Earthquake Early Warning: A Review' - Reviews of Geophysics 2025
  - lellouch2024das: 'Real-Time Earthquake Detection with Fiber-Optic DAS Arrays Using Deep Learning' - Nature Communications 2024
  - williams2025mems: 'MEMS Accelerometer Networks with Edge AI for Urban EEW' - SRL 2025

  - Add NEW subsection: 'Operational Challenges and Lessons Learned 2024-2026' discussing real-world deployment feedback
